liclip.title: Check who can spend your crypto, in 60 seconds
liclip.li_text:
Who can spend your crypto right now? Most people have never checked.

Every time you use a crypto app, you may give its smart contract permission to move your tokens. Many of those permissions are unlimited, and they stay live until you remove them.

This one-minute clip from my new YouTube video shows the check:
→ Open revoke.cash (type it yourself, don't click a link)
→ Paste your wallet address. You don't even need to connect to look
→ Look for three things: anything unlimited, a spender you don't recognise, and apps you used once months ago
→ Do it on every network you've used. An approval on Base doesn't show up on Ethereum

The full six-minute walkthrough, including how to revoke and what it costs, is on my YouTube channel.

Education, not financial advice.

Which network do you use most: Ethereum, Base, BNB Chain, Solana or something else?
